en: Add task templates beside the message composer. Save a draft or create a template, search and edit saved instructions, and confirm before deleting a template.

Insert a template as an expandable text card while keeping the current draft. Templates are stored locally, shared across accounts, and retained after restart and source-to-installer migration. Inserting a template does not send a message; attachments and account credentials are not saved in templates.
zh: 在输入框旁加入任务模板入口：可将草稿保存为模板，也可新建、搜索和编辑模板，删除前需确认。
模板以可展开的文字卡片插入，保留当前草稿。本机模板供不同账号共用，重启及从源码版转到安装版后仍保留；插入不会自动发送，模板不保存附件或账号凭据。
